clean_text: [MDA_P001] MANAGEMENT DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OVERVIEW OF THE GROUPS’ BUSINESS AND OPERATIONS Oriental Food Industries Holdings Berhad ("the Company” or “the Group”) has made its mark in the snack food and confectionery manufacturing industry today as one of the companies holding the leading position in the said industry in Malaysia. The Group remains focused on placing the needs and interests of its customers first by manufacturing an assortment of snack food and confectionery products that focuses on quality. Generally, these products can be divided into four (5) broad categories, which are snack food, wafer, biscuits, potato snacks and bakery products. The Group has various product brand names, most of which are commercially strong and generating the required sales and profit both locally and oversea. Super Ring, Jacker, Rota and Oriental are currently well-known household brand names in Malaysia. FINANCIAL POSITION The Group’s financial position remains strong with total assets of RM248.8 million against total liabilities of RM53.8 million. The Group has a cash reserve of RM14.8 million at the financial year-end as compared to RM9.5 million in the previous financial year. One of its major subsidiaries is currently in its final stage of expansion and the Group expects positive contribution in the coming years from the investment made. Net tangible assets per share, attributable to the owner improved to RM0.81 (2019: RM0.79). The net debt-to-equity ratio of the Group stood at Nil (2019: 8.62%) and the shareholders’ fund is RM194.9 million. The Group’s liquidity, measures by the current ratio is 3.1.

GROUP’s PROSPECTS The Group is in its final stage of expansion and currently pending for some minor machine acquisition to complete its new production lines. These new lines are expected to contribute positively to the growth and profitability of the Group. The management views the current year contraction in revenue is just a temporary setback due to the pandemic and slowdown in the global economy. The Group still expects a positive contribution from the investment in various product lines in years to come from the new and existing market segment due to the active promotional activities taken. The Board expects that the performance of the Group will be satisfactory for the next financial year ending 31 March 2021, despite facing various challenges of competitive markets.
